oij.publisher: Organismo de Investigación Judicial (OIJ), Poder Judicial de Costa Rica
oij.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the OIJ statistics application page
oij.years: 2010-2026 (2026 = 1 Jan to 16 Oct 2026, partial); 2010-2013 contain only 1-2 records each - the system effectively covers 2014 onward
oij.notes: Source publishes one row per victim (Delito, SubDelito/motive, Fecha, Hora band, Victima, SubVictima, Edad group, Sexo, Nacionalidad, Provincia, Canton, Distrito). Values here are counts of those rows grouped by area, year (from Fecha) and each published field, nothing else. OIJ category HOMICIDIO = homicidios dolosos (intentional). An area/year/breakdown with no row had no records in the download. The CSV export of the same endpoint drops a column, so the HTML export was used. 2026 is partial (to 16 Oct 2026). District shapes come from geoBoundaries ADM3, which lacks some districts (e.g. all of Coto Brus, Escazú San Rafael); those district rows are kept with empty shape_id. Monteverde canton (created 2021) has no ADM2 feature; Monteverde district matched to geoBoundaries ADM3 "Monte Verde". geoBoundaries ADM2 "Palmeras" is Palmares canton (Alajuela); "Leon Cortes Castro" = LEON CORTES; "Vazquez de Coronado" = VASQUEZ DE CORONADO.
